attributes.label: Busbar ratings
attributes.name: rated_current
attributes.quote: IBAR’s HX range provides a high-power feeder busbar solution with busbar ratings ranging from 800A up to 6300A.

attributes.label: IP rating
attributes.name: ip_rating
attributes.quote: HX utilises a sandwich arrangement of individually insulated Copper (HXC) busbars (using a specialist epoxy resin coating) which are contained within a unique two piece, IP55 rated, Aluminium trunking/housing.

attributes.label: British Standards
attributes.name: standards
attributes.quote: All IBAR product is manufactured within the UK to the latest British Standards (BS EN 61439-6).
